title: Why your team processes suck
summary: A team process without a principle underneath it is a real problem. Here's why the "why" is worth protecting as you scale.
body_markdown: Usually because the format was tuned for a smaller scale and nobody revisited the principle when the scale changed. Our Linear project updates worked great at three projects and fell apart at fifteen, not because the template was wrong but because "visibility at the right altitude" stopped being possible when updates were scattered across fifteen projects on different days. The principle was still valid but the format had outgrown it.
